title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Restocking Percent by Gift Condition
content:
The registry restocking percent of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry follows the gift's condition on the return record kept with Merchandise Purchases and, for an opened gift, the calendar days from the registry's event date to the date the return was authorized, because a registry gift is usually opened only once the occasion has passed. The registry restocking charge on the gift applies this percent and is deducted from the registry credit for the gift.

1. A gift returned damaged, for a reason that is not a fee-waiver reason, takes the damaged restocking percent of **25**.
2. A gift returned opened and unused, for a reason that is not a fee-waiver reason, more than the open-box grace days of **30** after the event date takes the opened restocking percent of **15**.
3. A gift returned opened and unused, for a reason that is not a fee-waiver reason, at most the 30 open-box grace days after the event date, a return authorized before the event date included, takes the grace restocking percent of **5**.
4. Otherwise no registry restocking percent applies.

The fee-waiver reasons are defective, damaged in transit and not as described.

## Decision table

| Condition on the return record | Fee-waiver reason | Days from the event date to the return authorization | Restocking percent |
|---|---|---|---|
| damaged | no | any | 25 |
| opened and unused | no | more than 30 | 15 |
| opened and unused | no | 30 or fewer (including before the event date) | 5 |
| damaged or opened and unused | yes | any | none |
| any other condition | any | any | none |

## Boundary (hypothetical event date 10 May)

An opened, unused gift returned for a reason that is not a fee-waiver reason: return authorized 9 June (30 days) → 5 percent; authorized 10 June (31 days) → 15 percent.
